A1.justification: Both PDFs describe RobustSplat and contain readable main text and supplementary material. Inspection of all pages supports matching the methods, equations, experiments, tables and figures across the revision.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction experiments, component ablations and qualitative analyses on NeRF On-the-go and RobustNeRF, including additional On-the-go scenes in the supplement.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds runtime measurements and further component ablations in supplementary Tables S1-S3.

M1.justification: Delayed Gaussian growth, scale-cascaded mask supervision, DINOv2/MLP masking and mask regularization are retained. The newly stated pruning start time is additional implementation disclosure; the PDFs do not establish that the underlying procedure changed.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same twelve NeRF On-the-go scenes and four RobustNeRF scenes. The On-the-go II evaluation moves from supplementary Section C/Table S1 to Section E/Table S4. New runtime and ablation experiments use existing scenes.

E2.justification: v3 adds the explicitly evaluated 'Ours w/o MR' comparison control in Table S2. The external baseline roster remains unchanged, and the runtime comparison reuses 3DGS, SpotLessSplats and WildGaussians. SpotLessSplat/SpotLessSplats and Robust3DGS/Robust3DGaussians are naming corrections.

E3.justification: The new runtime evaluation measures minutes on an NVIDIA RTX 3090 and separates SpotLessSplats training from feature-extraction time. Existing reconstruction protocols retain their training budget, downsampling, camera settings and accuracy metrics; no revision to those settings is reported.

E4.justification: Supplementary Table S2 newly isolates mask regularization by removing it. Table S3 extends the earlier densification analysis with six-scene comparisons of vanilla 3DGS, 3DGS with delayed growth, and RobustSplat. These targeted additions supplement the retained ablations and case studies.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The added tables continue reporting point estimates without uncertainty; averages across scenes are not repeated-run statistics.

E6.justification: Tables S1-S3 add runtime and ablation results. For example, Mountain runtime is 15.43 minutes for RobustSplat versus 12.21 for 3DGS; Spot PSNR is 25.63 without mask regularization versus 26.21 for the full model. All earlier numerical results, including v1 Table S1 relocated as v3 Table S4, are retained.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(9), including rendering, masking and regularization definitions, remain mathematically unchanged. Neither version contains additional theoretical propositions or proofs; relocating Equation (9) does not change its substance.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about densification-induced artifacts, the two principal designs, and improved transient-free reconstruction. The supplementary additions provide evidence without redefining these core claims.

C2.justification: The new runtime discussion explains that SpotLessSplats has similar optimization time but substantial upfront SD feature-extraction overhead. Additional ablation discussion reinforces the limitations of delayed growth without masking. Existing illumination, initialization and feature-boundary limitations are retained.

D1.justification: Supplementary Section B newly specifies that pruning starts at 10,000 iterations. Section C additionally documents feature dimensions, evaluation hardware, per-scene image counts and runtimes. These improve technical disclosure without demonstrating changes to previously used settings or resource availability.

R1.justification: The same 64 cited works and substantive related-work positioning are retained. Bibliography reflow and changed citation back-references do not introduce or remove research relationships.

P1.justification: v3 standardizes several method names and capitalization, updates affiliations and corresponding-author information, adds acknowledgements, and inserts two supplementary sections. The main narrative remains essentially unchanged rather than extensively rewritten.

P2.justification: v3 adds three supplementary tables and relocates the original On-the-go II table as Table S4. Table widths, figure-label presentation and surrounding layout receive limited adjustments. Existing figures and their qualitative examples are retained.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1, the runtime measurements and targeted ablations make computational costs and component contributions easier to assess, while the pruning disclosure improves reproducibility. These address limited omissions without changing the main method or original benchmark evidence. The additions remain incremental and provide no uncertainty estimates.
